frictions.description: When chaining multiple filter selects (fill search + select category + select date range) in a single command chain, the category selection sometimes does not take effect if element refs become stale. Required re-snapshotting to get fresh refs and selecting category separately.
frictions.resolution: Re-snapshotted after page interaction to get fresh element refs, then applied filters one by one

summary: Tested 10 assertions: all 10 passed. Search by title (VAL-SRCH-001) and by notes (VAL-SRCH-002) work correctly via iLIKE matching on both fields. Category filter (VAL-SRCH-003) correctly isolates by categoryId. Date range presets 'This Month' (VAL-SRCH-004) and 'Last Month' (VAL-SRCH-005) return correct month boundaries. Custom date range (VAL-SRCH-006) works with inclusive start/end dates. Amount range filter (VAL-SRCH-007) using amountMin/amountMax params functions correctly. Combining all three filters (VAL-SRCH-008) applies AND logic properly. Empty state (VAL-SRCH-009) shows a proper 'No transactions found' message with helper text. Clear Filters (VAL-SRCH-010) resets all filters and restores the full list.
